name: Verifiable Credentialing
short_description: API-first credentialing platform with real-time PSV, continuous monitoring, and sanctions screening. Per-verification pricing from $15. SOC 2 + ISO 27001 certified.
description: Verifiable is a healthcare credentialing and provider data management platform that offers real-time primary source verification, automated license monitoring, and comprehensive provider network management. The platform serves health systems, payers, and digital health companies with API-first credential verification services.

core_features.name: Real-Time Primary Source Verification
core_features.description: Instant verification of provider credentials including medical licenses, DEA registration, board certifications, and education directly from original sources

core_features.name: Continuous License Monitoring
core_features.description: 24/7 automated monitoring of license status, expirations, and disciplinary actions across all 50 states

core_features.name: Sanctions Screening
core_features.description: Automated OIG, SAM, state Medicaid exclusion list, and sanctions database screening with real-time alerts

core_features.name: Credentialing API
core_features.description: RESTful API for integrating verification services into existing workflows and applications

core_features.name: Provider Directory Management
core_features.description: Tools for maintaining accurate and compliant provider directories required by CMS and state regulations

core_features.name: Bulk Verification
core_features.description: Mass verification capabilities for organizations onboarding or re-credentialing large provider networks

mental_health_specific: Psychology and counseling license verification across all states
Social work license (LCSW, LMSW) credential tracking

pricing.notes: Per-verification pricing decreases significantly with volume. Annual contracts available with additional discounts.

integrations.name: Salesforce
integrations.description: Native integration for provider management workflows

best_for: Digital health companies needing API-based verification
Health plans requiring provider directory accuracy
Telehealth platforms onboarding providers at scale
Organizations prioritizing real-time verification over managed services
not_ideal_for: Small practices with minimal verification needs
Organizations without technical resources for API integration
